WHAT: Function that groups flat Whisper token array into word-level timings
WHERE: src-tauri/src/features/transcription/whisper_utils.rs

HOW:
- token.to_str_lossy() extracts text from each token
- Tokens starting with ' ' (space) mark the start of a new word
- word.start_ms = first token's DTW timestamp
- word.end_ms = next word's start_ms, or segment end_ms for last word
- Leading space preserved in word.text (e.g., " transcript") — required for Remotion whiteSpace: "pre" rendering

WHY: Whisper's BPE tokenization uses space-prefix to indicate word boundaries — this is the canonical way to group tokens into words
GOTCHA: Special tokens (timestamps, language tags) need to be filtered out before grouping
